# `contains`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a boolean. The value is True if right is found inside left.
Returns NULL if either input expression is NULL. Otherwise, returns False.
Both left or right must be of STRING or BINARY type.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
contains(left, right)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- contains, example 1
> SELECT contains('Spark SQL', 'Spark');
true
```

```sql
-- contains, example 2
> SELECT contains('Spark SQL', 'SPARK');
false
```

```sql
-- contains, example 3
> SELECT contains('Spark SQL', null);
NULL
```

```sql
-- contains, example 4
> SELECT contains(x'537061726b2053514c', x'537061726b');
true
```
